speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you haven't provided the patient's specific symptoms or history yet; could you describe your gait difficulties, any limb ataxia you experience, and your significant medical background? This will help me determine the next steps for your evaluation.

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description; the "drunk" appearance and right-sided clumsiness strongly suggest cerebellar involvement. Given your significant medical history, have you been diagnosed with any autoimmune conditions, or do you have a family history of early-onset ataxia? Also, have you experienced any episodes of vertigo, double vision, or difficulty swallowing alongside these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neurodegenerative Ataxia Associated with Natalizumab Therapy (likely Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy or PML).

REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain with contrast.
REQUEST TEST: JC Virus PCR from CSF.
